name: Exp_ColorXMACDCandle
summary: This EA trades based on color changes of the ColorXMACDCandle custom indicator, which is an enhanced MACD with multiple smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns bullish and sell positions when it turns bearish, with configurable signal modes (histogram or signal line crossover). Position sizing follows one of five money management modes including fixed lot and percentage-based allocation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXMACDCandle自定义指标的颜色变化进行交易，该指标是带有多种平滑算法的增强型MACD。当直方图转牛时开多仓，转熊时开空仓，支持直方图和信号线交叉两种信号模式。仓位管理支持固定手数和按资金比例分配等五种模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ColorXMACDCandle指标的动量方向变化进行交易。入场条件分为两种模式：直方图模式下，当指标颜色从非牛转为牛（Clr[1]==2且Clr[0]<2）时开多，从非熊转为熊（Clr[1]==0且Clr[0]>0）时开空；信号线模式下，当颜色从非多转为多（Clr[1]==1且Clr[0]!=1）时开多，从非空转为空（Clr[1]==2且Clr[0]!=2）时开空。出场条件包括反向信号触发时平仓以及固定的止损止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、按余额百分比、按净值百分比、按可用保证金百分比和按亏损后余额百分比计算。指标采用可配置的平滑方法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA），分别用于快慢MACD线和信号线的计算，提供了远超标准MACD的灵活性。止损1000点、止盈2000点的默认设置表明策略倾向于让利润奔跑，盈亏比2:1。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core trades on momentum direction changes of the ColorXMACDCandle indicator. Entry conditions have two modes: in Histogram mode, a buy opens when the indicator color shifts to bullish (Clr[1]==2 and Clr[0]<2), and a sell opens when it shifts to bearish (Clr[1]==0 and Clr[0]>0); in SignalLine mode, a buy opens when color shifts to up (Clr[1]==1 and Clr[0]!=1), and a sell when it shifts to down (Clr[1]==2 and Clr[0]!=2). Exit conditions include closing on reverse signals and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of balance, percentage of equity, percentage of free margin, and percentage of balance after deducting losses. The indicator uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) for both the fast/slow MACD lines and the signal line, offering far more flexibility than standard MACD. Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points indicate a trend-letting approach with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.

parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size

parameters.description: 仓位管理模式（固定手数/按余额/按净值/按可用保证金/按亏损后余额）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net free margin/net balance/fixed lot)

parameters.description: 信号模式（直方图/信号线）

parameters.description: 应用价格类型（收盘/开盘/最高/最低）

parameters.description: 信号获取的K线索引（0=当前bar，1=已完成bar）

pros: 支持多种高级平滑算法（JJMA/JurX/T3等），比标准MACD信号更平滑、更灵敏
提供两种信号模式（直方图和信号线），交易者可根据市场状况灵活选择
仓位管理提供五种模式，资金控制灵活度高
信号基于已完成K线（SignalBar=1），避免当前bar信号闪烁导致反复开平仓
止损止盈默认2:1盈亏比，符合趋势跟踪策略的正期望值设计
支持独立控制多空开仓和平仓开关，可只做单边或仅平仓不开仓
pros_en: Supports multiple advanced smoothing algorithms (JJMA/JurX/T3 etc.), producing smoother and more responsive signals than standard MACD
Provides two signal modes (histogram and signal line), allowing traders to flexibly choose based on market conditions
Five money management modes offer high flexibility in position sizing control
Signals based on completed bars (SignalBar=1), avoiding signal flickering and repeated open/close on the current bar
Default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio aligns with trend-following positive expectancy design
Independent buy/sell open and close switches allow single-direction trading or close-only mode
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorXMACDCandle，若无该指标文件则EA完全无法运行
止损1000点数值较大，在波动剧烈市场中可能造成较大单笔亏损
缺乏加仓和移动止损机制，无法在趋势行情中最大化利润
未做spread过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能因信号频繁而造成连续亏损
代码注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响可读性和维护性
未检查订单是否已存在，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on the custom ColorXMACDCandle indicator; EA is completely non-functional without it
Stop-loss of 1000 points is large and may cause significant single-trade losses in volatile markets
Lacks position scaling and trailing stop mechanisms, unable to maximize profits in trending markets
No spread filter; frequent signals on high-spread instruments may cause consecutive losses
Code comments are garbled (encoding issue), severely hurting readability and maintainability
No check for existing orders; may repeatedly open positions on the same signal
improvements: 增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
增加点差过滤和最小信号间隔，避免在高点差或密集信号环境下过度交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同一信号方向重复开仓
修复源文件编码问题，将乱码注释恢复为可读的俄语或翻译为英语
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending moves
Add spread filter and minimum signal interval to prevent overtrading in high-spread or dense signal environments
Add position existence check to avoid duplicate entries in the same signal direction
Fix source file encoding issue to restore garbled comments to readable Russian or translate to English

risk_points: 未检查当前是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓放大风险
默认止损1000点较大，在小账户或高杠杆下可能单笔亏损占比较高
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或更新不兼容将导致策略失效
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially causing duplicate entries that amplify risk
Default 1000-point stop-loss is large; single-trade loss percentage could be high on small accounts or high leverage
Depends on external custom indicator; missing or incompatible indicator file will cause strategy failure
